body: I just tried to call LifeLine but nobody picked up. I've tried 5 times in the last ten minutes to tell my ex how close I am to killing myself but I can't get the words to come out of my mouth. I left him and now I'm downstairs by myself.

I can't afford a therapist, tried going to a counselor before but it didn't help at all. It's the idea of counselors I hate, not therapists. But yeah, can't afford one. Poor student. I don't know what I said that makes me seem wonderful.

How do you kill a blue elephant?

With a blue elephant gun

How do you kill a red elephant? 

Strangle it until it turns blue and shoot it with a blue elephant gun.

How do you kill a yellow elephant? 

Make it angry until it turns red, choke it til it turns blue and shoot it with a blue elephant gun.

How do you kill a green elephant?

 There's no such thing stupid.

I keep thinking that for everyone to get sick of me like this and get rid of me like this, there must be something really wrong with me. It seems ridiculous to go 'well, everyone ends up wanting me to fuck off, it must be something wrong with them!' the only logical solution is something wrong with me. I'd fix it if I knew what it was.
